irrigation_evidence.claim: For the described paired-row drip setup, the TNAU guidance says irrigation once in three days based on evapotranspiration demand. Its applicability details include 12 mm laterals, 240 cm lateral spacing, 8 LPH emitters at 75 cm spacing, and 30-40 m laterals. This is Tamil Nadu guidance and is not approved as a Maharashtra recommendation.
irrigation_evidence.applicable_crop_stage: all stages; the source does not give a stage-specific drip interval
